title: Which side of the directed line?
hook: Which side of the directed line? Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Cartesian coordinates, determinant sign, Euclidean distance.
doesNotKnow: Use a signed cross product to classify a point as left, right or collinear relative to a directed segment.

misconception: Comparing slopes is the safest way to test which side a point lies on.
objective: Use a signed cross product to classify a point as left, right or collinear relative to a directed segment.

claims.text: The signed cross product compares the point with the directed segment. Positive, zero and negative values preserve orientation without slope division, including collinear and vertical configurations.
